scope: Proposition 3.7 (One-block all-radii propagation) of the manuscript “Projection moments, positive cap domination, and Riesz estimates on the sphere” (preprints/Projection-moments-positive-cap-domination-and-Riesz-estimates-on-the-sphere-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 140 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2a212c32e3e62170), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For sufficiently large d, use k = q = ⌊d/4⌋ and β = d − 1 − q. Let f1, . . . , fN : Sd−1 → [0, 1] be Borel functions satisfying Z B(b,t) fw dσ ≤ Ktβ (b ∈ Rd , t > 0, 1 ≤ w ≤ N). Let Qw(X, y) be nonnegative Borel functions on Rk×d × Rk with P w Qw ≤ 1, and define fin(s) = EX N X w=1 Qw(X, Xs)fw(s). Then Z B(z,R) fin dσ ≤ Cd N1/q KRβ (z ∈ Rd , R > 0). (15)
